question.text: How many nine-dart finishes will there be in the 2026 Grand Slam of Darts?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the number of nine-dart finishes achieved during the 2026 Grand Slam of Darts, according to [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions).

research:
The 2026 Grand Slam has not started yet, so nothing is settled. It runs 14-22 November 2026 in Wolverhampton. Across 19 editions (2007-2025) it has never had more than one nine-darter in a year, and there were none in 12 of them.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no specific source, only "credible sources". In practice that means the PDC (pdc.tv), the Wikipedia page for the 2026 event, and match reports from Sky or the BBC.
- 2026-10-26: The [2026 Grand Slam Wikipedia page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Grand_Slam_of_Darts) lists no nine-darters, as expected before the event. Its infobox gives 14-22 November 2026 at WV Active Aldersley, Wolverhampton. The body text has a typo reading "14 to 12 November".

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened that settles or nearly settles the question.
- 2026-02-11/12: The PDC and Sky confirmed the dates (14-22 November) and a 48-player field. The last eight places come from a Tour Card Holder Qualifier on 6 November. [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/darts/news/12040/13506330/grand-slam-of-darts-expands-to-48-player-field-for-first-time-at-wv-active-aldersley-in-wolverhampton-live-on-sky-sports), [PDC](https://www.pdc.tv/news/2026/february/11/2026-mr-vegas-grand-slam-of-darts-qualification-criteria-confirmed/)
- New format: 16 round-robin groups of three, with only the group winner advancing to a last 16. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Grand_Slam_of_Darts)
- That gives 48 group matches, then 8 + 4 + 2 + 1 knockout matches, for 63 in total. That is the same match count as 2025 (8 groups of four, then the same knockout rounds). This is my own arithmetic, based on the format as described.
- I could not find the 2026 match lengths. In 2025 they were best of 9 legs in the groups, best of 19 in the second round, and best of 31 from the quarter-finals on. [Wikipedia 2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_Grand_Slam_of_Darts) If 2026 uses longer matches, there will be more legs and more chances.
- One news item (Sportbible, 2026-10-25) mentions "November 21 in Minehead". That conflicts with every other source and looks like an error.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-25: Krzysztof Ratajski knocked world No. 1 Luke Littler out of the European Championship quarter-finals 10-6. [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/darts/news/13603410/luke-littler-suffers-shock-defeat-to-krzysztof-ratajski-at-european-championship-darts-in-dortmund)
- 2026-10-24: Luke Woodhouse hit a nine-darter against Dirk van Duijvenbode at the European Championship. This shows how often perfect legs are coming on TV this season. [Sky Sports live blog](https://www.skysports.com/darts/live-blog/13602923/european-championship-darts-game-by-game-updates-scores-analysis-with-luke-littler-and-gerwyn-price-in-action)
- 2026-10-24: The Express & Star confirmed the 14-22 November dates and the 48-player field. [Express & Star](https://www.expressandstar.com/news/grand-slam-of-darts-returns-to-wolverhampton-everything-you-need-to-know-about-the-annual-carnival-of-darts-9301060)
- 2026 season: a BBC piece (seen only as a search snippet, the page now returns 404) said 2026 is on track to be a record year for nine-darters. As of Players Championship 29 there had been 17 in that series. Televised ones this year include Danny Noppert at the UK Open and Josh Rock in the Premier League. [Wikipedia nine-dart finish](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nine-dart_finish), [2026 Players Championship series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_PDC_Players_Championship_series), [2026 UK Open](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_UK_Open)

## 4. Base rates
- Grand Slam nine-darters by year [Dartsnews list](https://dartsnews.com/pdc/video-watch-all-the-nine-darters-in-grand-slam-of-darts-history-right-here), [Dartsnews 2025](https://dartsnews.com/pdc/video-luke-humphries-wins-in-style-against-michael-smith-with-nine-dart-finish-at-grand-slam-of-darts):

| Year | Player | Opponent |
|---|---|---|
| 2008 | James Wade | Gary Anderson |
| 2014 | Kim Huybrechts | Michael van Gerwen |
| 2015 | Dave Chisnall | Peter Wright |
| 2018 | Dimitri van den Bergh | Stephen Bunting |
| 2022 | Josh Rock | Michael van Gerwen |
| 2023 | Ryan Searle | Nathan Rafferty |
| 2025 | Luke Humphries | Michael Smith |

- That is 7 nine-darters in 19 editions, about 0.37 per event. There were 0 in 12 years and exactly 1 in 7 years. No edition has had 2 or more.
- Recent trend: 2022: 1, 2023: 1, 2024: 0, 2025: 1. That is 3 in 4 years, about 0.75 per event.
- The match count is unchanged for 2026, but the overall rate of nine-darters across the sport is rising.

## 5. Other forecasts
- No Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this question that I could find.
- The Kalshi prices supplied are for the PDC World Championship winner and for tennis and golf "Grand Slams". None of them match this question.
- I could not find any bookmaker odds for a nine-darter at the 2026 Grand Slam. Bookmakers usually post a "nine-darter in tournament" market close to the event.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-06: Tour Card Holder Qualifier, which fills the last 8 or more places. [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/darts/news/12040/13506330/grand-slam-of-darts-expands-to-48-player-field-for-first-time-at-wv-active-aldersley-in-wolverhampton-live-on-sky-sports)
- Before the event: the group draw and the official schedule. These should confirm the match lengths, which is the main unknown for how many legs get played.
- 2026-11-14 to 11-22: the tournament itself, 63 matches, with the final on 22 November. The question resolves around 23 November.
